an8.16:2.2: uggavādiniṁ → uggavādinaṁ (bj: sīmu) | uggavādiniṁ → uggavādinaṁ (cck: sī.); uggahavādinaṁ (cck: syā. pī.); uggatavādiniṁ (cck: ka.)
an8.16:3.1: asandiddhañca → asandiṭṭhaṁ te (sya-all) | bhaṇati → asandiddho ca akkhāti (cck: cūḷava. 347)
